title: Tanzanian Chicken and Potato Stew
author: Mama Salima
desc: Mchuzi wa Kuku na Viazi — chicken and potato stew. Bone-in chicken and potato chunks simmered in a fragrant tomato sauce until both are perfectly tender. The affordable, complete, everyday Tanzanian family stew.
longDesc: Chicken and potato stew is the weekday workhorse of Tanzanian family cooking — the stew that appears when resources are limited but the family needs a complete, satisfying meal. Chicken extends further with potatoes alongside, and the potatoes absorb all the flavours of the stew.
steps: Add garlic, ginger, spices, tomatoes. Cook 6 minutes.
Return chicken. Add water. Simmer 20 minutes.
Add potatoes. Simmer 20 more minutes until tender.
chefTips: Bone-in chicken gives much more flavour.
Add potatoes when chicken is half-cooked.
cookingScience: See TZA046 for potato starch thickening science.
culturalNote: Chicken and potato stew is the daily meal of Tanzania's working families — reliable, affordable, and deeply satisfying. It appears on every mama lishe menu and in every family pot across the country.
